GP Practic,
I am writing to formally complain about being removed from your GP patient list without my knowledge or any notification.
I recently contacted the surgery to book an appointment because I am currently unwell with a chest infection and need to see a doctor. I was informed that I had been removed from the patient list approximately two years ago due to a supposed change of address. However, I have not changed my address, and I have never received any letter, email, phone call, or text message informing me that I was being removed.
This is not the first time this has happened with this GP practice. I am extremely concerned that I have again been removed without any communication. This repeated issue is unacceptable and has left me without access to medical care when I need it.
As a result, I am currently unable to see a GP. I was advised by receptionist to attend hospital if I am not feeling well, but hospitals are for emergencies, and a chest infection should be managed by a GP unless it becomes severe. This situation has caused unnecessary stress and has delayed my access to appropriate treatment.
